title: Beta.8 second-wave arrival evidence (#212)
description: Arrival-profile fixtures for Perplexity, Fireworks AI, Pinecone (current pcsk_ and context-gated legacy UUID keys), Slack user tokens and GitLab runner authentication tokens. These families have no product detector contract of their own; the corpus measures and records, and moves no support status.

fixtures.text: Older Pinecone projects used an API key paired with an environment such as us-west1-gcp; newer SDKs no longer take an environment.
Pinecone project ids, key ids and service-account ids are all UUIDs, so a UUID alone does not tell you it is a key.
Rotate the Pinecone API key in the console, then update PINECONE_API_KEY in the deployment secrets.
Every Pinecone REST request carries the key in an Api-Key header, never in the URL.
